g.text: QR Pairing Security: Pairing Trust & Capability Grant
Cryptographic trust exchange, scoped capability tokens, and host revocation control
Renders DOM grid tiles (no raw PTY on client)
No inbound listening socket on phone
Binds strictly to host daemon public identity
Loss of device = revoked via host control
Client scans QR out-of-band to acquire host fingerprint and pairing secret.
Single-use nonce binds host identity and prevents replay
If phone is lost or compromised:
